name: arkada
description: Tells the other dev.txt apps on this PC what Steam is doing, sends Steam notifications to Kapsula, shows the size on disk and How Long To Beat times of a game, Dota 2 statistics on profiles and adds Share to store pages. Only How Long To Beat (howlongtobeat.com) and Dota 2 statistics (api.opendota.com) go to the internet, each while its setting is on.
